paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the variation in Macro-F1 scores in percentage as a function of the parameter . The x-axis is labeled as " value," displaying a scale ranging from "w/o" to 3 with regularly spaced tick marks at intervals of 0.1 between 0 and 1, and 1-unit intervals from 1 to 3. The y-axis indicates the "Macro-F1 Score (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from 52 to 58, with tick labels at 1-unit intervals. There are two lines on the plot. The first line represents "MatDetector (ours)" and is shown in pink with circular markers and a solid line style. This line starts at approximately 53%, majorly fluctuates till it increases to a peak at around 58% at = 1, and then declines towards 53.5% at = 3. The second line stands for "ChemDataExtractor," displayed in blue with square markers and a dashed line style. It begins at around 53%, shows variation, peaking at approximately 55.2% at = 1, and ends just above to 54% at = 3.A legend positioned near the top-left of the plot defines each line by its corresponding conditional information, marker shape, and color
